name: issuetracker
description: Open source, self-hosted issue tracker with configurable GitLab source-of-truth sync, role-based dashboards, and SLA timelines.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tracker/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracker/server && npm run build --workspace @tracker/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @tracker/server & npm run dev --workspace @tracker/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @tracker/server && npm run test --workspace @tracker/web
